findings.summary: Firecrawl Search Tool sidebar entry was replaced (not augmented) by Oxylabs, orphaning the still-existing firecrawlsearchtool.mdx page from sidebar navigation while the overview page still links to it
findings.failure_scenario: A user navigating the docs sidebar under 'Web Scraping & Browsing' no longer sees Firecrawl Search Tool. The firecrawlsearchtool.mdx page file still exists on disk at docs/tools/web-scraping/firecrawlsearchtool.mdx and the overview page at docs/tools/web-scraping/overview.mdx line 28 still shows a Card linking to it, but there is zero sidebar entry for it anywhere in docs.json — the page is effectively hidden from discovery unless the user clicks through from the overview CardGroup.

findings.summary: Wrong domain description in OxylabsAmazonSearchScraperTool parameters: 'Domain localization for Bestbuy' should say 'Amazon' (this is an Amazon search tool, not Bestbuy)
findings.failure_scenario: A developer reading the OxylabsAmazonSearchScraperTool parameter docs sees 'Domain localization for Bestbuy' for the domain parameter and is confused about whether this is an Amazon or Bestbuy tool, or worse, configures a Bestbuy domain for an Amazon search query.

findings.summary: Typo in frontmatter description: 'Google Seach' should be 'Google Search'
findings.failure_scenario: The published documentation page displays 'Google Seach' as one of the available scraper sources, a visible typo that reduces trust in documentation accuracy.
